description: Resource type definition for AWS::IoTManagedIntegrations::OtaTask. An over-the-air (OTA) task deploys a firmware update to targeted managed things through AWS IoT managed integrations.

RetryConfigCriteria.description: Structure representing one retry configuration criteria for an over-the-air (OTA) task.

FailureType.description: The over-the-air (OTA) retry criteria failure type.

MinNumberOfRetries.description: The number of retries allowed for a failure type for the over-the-air (OTA) task.

OtaTaskExecutionRetryConfig.description: The execution retry configuration for an over-the-air (OTA) task.

RetryConfigCriteria.description: The list of retry configuration criteria.

ScheduleMaintenanceWindow.description: A recurring maintenance window with a predetermined start time and duration for the rollout of the over-the-air (OTA) task.

StartTime.description: The cron expression that determines the start time of the recurring maintenance window.

DurationInMinutes.description: The duration of the maintenance window in minutes.

OtaTaskSchedulingConfig.description: The scheduling configuration for an over-the-air (OTA) task.

EndBehavior.description: Specifies the end behavior for all over-the-air (OTA) task executions after the task reaches the selected end time. If an end time is not selected when creating the task, then the end behavior does not apply.

EndTime.description: The time an over-the-air (OTA) task will stop.

MaintenanceWindows.description: The list of maintenance windows for the over-the-air (OTA) task scheduling configuration.

StartTime.description: The time an over-the-air (OTA) task will start.

TaskProcessingDetails.description: Details about the over-the-air (OTA) task process.

NumberOfCanceledThings.description: The number of canceled things in an over-the-air (OTA) task.

NumberOfFailedThings.description: The number of failed things in an over-the-air (OTA) task.

NumberOfInProgressThings.description: The number of in progress things in an over-the-air (OTA) task.

NumberOfQueuedThings.description: The number of queued things in an over-the-air (OTA) task.

NumberOfRejectedThings.description: The number of rejected things in an over-the-air (OTA) task.

NumberOfRemovedThings.description: The number of removed things in an over-the-air (OTA) task.

NumberOfSucceededThings.description: The number of succeeded things in an over-the-air (OTA) task.

NumberOfTimedOutThings.description: The number of timed out things in an over-the-air (OTA) task.

ProcessingTargets.description: The targets of the over-the-air (OTA) task.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with the over-the-air (OTA) task.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the over-the-air (OTA) task.

TaskId.description: The unique identifier of the over-the-air (OTA) task.

Description.description: The description of the over-the-air (OTA) task.

S3Url.description: The URL to the Amazon S3 bucket where the over-the-air (OTA) task is stored.

Protocol.description: The connection protocol the over-the-air (OTA) task uses to update the device.

Target.description: The managed things targeted by the over-the-air (OTA) task.

TaskConfigurationId.description: The identifier for the over-the-air (OTA) task configuration.

OtaMechanism.description: The deployment mechanism for the over-the-air (OTA) task.

OtaType.description: The frequency type for the over-the-air (OTA) task.

OtaTargetQueryString.description: The query string to add managed things to the thing group targeted by the over-the-air (OTA) task.

Status.description: The status of the over-the-air (OTA) task.

CreatedAt.description: The timestamp value of when the over-the-air (OTA) task was created.

LastUpdatedAt.description: The timestamp value of when the over-the-air (OTA) task was last updated.

Tags.description: A set of key/value pairs that are used to manage the over-the-air (OTA) task.
